decisions.reason: Although more peripheral than the firm's core machinery offer, it stayed on the home page through 2024 and, given the firm's growth and organizational slack, management would likely keep it as long as performance is at least near aspiration or strategically useful for ecosystem building.

As a stated flagship with its own page in both years, Product B appears to remain central to the firm's search around circular, low-emission solutions, so a growing and R&D-active firm would likely continue backing it rather than redeploy resources now.

Product C is close to the established business, remained prominently featured on the home page in 2024, and fits the firm's technical capabilities well, so its observed standing is most consistent with results meeting or exceeding aspiration enough to retain it.
